policy: Only lawfully licensed vocal recordings with documented provenance; no uncontrolled extraction from commercial music or videos; no use to mislabel AI vocals as human performances.

sources.name: VocalSet
sources.description: Monophonic recorded singers, vowels, scales, standard and extended singing techniques
sources.suitability: Strong scientific reference for singing gestures and controlled vowels, but the corpus is mostly mono

sources.name: Vocadito
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 per publication; confirm distribution source before downloading
sources.suitability: Short multilingual solo human singing performances with pitch, note and lyric annotations

sources.name: LibriTTS
sources.suitability: Speech microtiming/phonetics and prosody; not a singing training standard

sources.name: LJ Speech
sources.suitability: Short single-speaker speech; not representative of male singing or stereo mixing

sources.name: Smule DAMP singing archives
sources.license: Special Smule Research Data License Agreement
sources.suitability: Multiple human singers but use is not freely unrestricted

sources.name: GTSinger
sources.suitability: Diverse techniques but license is noncommercial
